Exercise display names in previews and exports

Source: R/task_names.R
task_names.Rd

options(rqti.task_names = "title") selects a shared naming policy for qti.js previews, XML/ZIP conversion and LMS uploads. The default, when no option is set, is "title". A helper's task_names argument overrides the global option for that call.

Details

The available policies are:

  • "title": the exercise title, falling back to its source filename.

  • "filename": the source filename without its extension.

  • "both": Title (filename), omitting the duplicate when they match.

  • "hidden": generic labels such as Task 1.1, Section 1, and Test.

Objects created from Rmd retain the source basename so that later export can use it. For programmatically constructed objects with no source file, filename mode uses the identifier. Existing XML/ZIP inputs use their embedded titles and XML filenames; a title lost before import cannot be recovered. This changes display names, not identifiers, file paths or access settings.

Set the global option in the RStudio console; separate Knit sessions read current console settings from the running preview server without a restart. For a persistent preference, set the option in .Rprofile. This is an R option (options() / getOption()), not an environment variable (Sys.setenv() / Sys.getenv()). Prefer options for rqti settings; rqti manages the environment variables needed to coordinate separate processes.

The older fallback_titles constructor argument remains supported: "generic" selects hidden names and its historical "filename" value keeps supplied titles. Its default, "inherit", uses the global policy at export. An explicit task_names argument overrides this constructor setting too.

OPAL repository display names also use the selected exported title unless display_name is supplied explicitly. Existing resources keep their repository name when their content is replaced through the update endpoint.

See also

render_qtijs(), rmd2xml(), rmd2zip(), upload2opal()
